newsitem.title: UK: ScottishPower wins hospital energy supply contract.
newsitem.headline: ScottishPower wins hospital energy supply contract.

text.p: Glasgow-based ScottishPower has won a Private Finance Initiative (PFI) contract to supply a hospital in southern England with electricity, steam and gas for the next 20 years.

ScottishPower said in a statement on Friday that it will provide the North Hampshire Hospital in Basingstoke with a one-megawatt Combined Heat and Power (CHP) unit and gas boiler plant to meet its heat, steam and electricity needs.
It is the first PFI contract to be won by ScottishPower.
The hospital is in the region served by Southern Water, a subsidiary of ScottishPower.
The contract was awarded by North Hampshire Hospitals NHS Trust.
